mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above 4% for two consecutive months predicts a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days due to tightened discount rates eroding equity present value.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% and remains >4% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from the pre-tightening 20-day average (p > 0.05) during the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: When monthly PAYEMS rises by more than 10% from the prior month, it indicates strong labor demand, which precedes a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 trading days as firms expand hiring and invest.
failure_condition: Over 60-day horizon, 20-day forward returns are negative or flat despite the labor signal, with a p-value > 0.05 in a two-tailed test.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in INDPRO by at least 5 points suggests weakening manufacturing capacity, which is associated with a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days as market anticipates profit compression.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO month-over-month < -5 for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or the signal is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly HOUST exceeds 1200 units for three consecutive months, indicating robust industrial demand, the S&P 500 is expected to deliver a positive 20-day forward return as firms benefit from stronger orders.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during the signal period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in UNRATE below 3.5% for 4 consecutive months signals labor market softening, which tends to produce a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days as investors anticipate rate stability.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or the UNRATE signal is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly PAYEMS and RSAFS both rise simultaneously by at least 5% from the prior month, it reflects dual labor and demand strength, predicting a positive S&P 500 forward return over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > +5% AND RSAFS > +5% in the same month
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) despite the interaction signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in GDPC1 (quarterly) below 18,000 billion chained USD for two consecutive quarters suggests softening business demand, which is associated with a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < 18000 for two consecutive quarterly periods
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during the trigger.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 255 for two consecutive months, indicating accelerating inflation, the S&P 500 is expected to show a negative 20-day forward return as market anticipates rate hikes.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive or the CPIAUCSL trigger does not precede a positive return (p > 0.05).
